name: quorum-orchestrator
description: End-to-end Jira ticket delivery orchestrator. Drives a ticket through fetch → analyze → plan → implement → test → review → PR with human approval gates at every phase. Ships the quorum-orchestrator agent, sub-agents (quorum-ticket-analyzer, quorum-prompt-builder, quorum-pr-generator, quorum-qa-handoff-publisher, quorum-ticket-validator, quorum-ticket-image-analyzer, quorum-memory-synchronizer, quorum-decision-documenter, quorum-pattern-documenter, quorum-test-specialist), and the quorum-orchestrate / quorum-prompt-gen / quorum-pr-template / quorum-validate-ticket slash commands.
